## CVE-2026-62916

CVE-2026-62916 is an authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID arising from the use of an alternate path or channel. This vulnerability permits an unauthorized remote attacker to perform privilege escalation within the identity management environment.

Affected products:
- Entra ID

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-62916
























































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































































Related in this roundup: [CVE-2026-83941](#cve-2026-83941).

## CVE-2026-70352

CVE-2026-70352 describes a critical vulnerability in Microsoft's Azure AI Language service where a missing authentication control on a critical function allows an unauthorized remote attacker to perform privilege escalation. The vulnerability carries a CVSS base score of 10.0, indicating high severity and potential for exploitation over a network.

Affected products:
- Azure AI Language

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-70352

## CVE-2026-80098

CVE-2026-80098 is a vulnerability in Microsoft Copilot Studio involving improper verification of cryptographic signatures. This flaw allows an unauthorized attacker to perform a privilege escalation attack over a network, presenting a significant security risk given its high CVSS base score.

Affected products:
- Copilot Studio

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-80098

## CVE-2026-83711

An authorization bypass vulnerability exists in Microsoft Azure Active Directory B2C due to improper handling of user-controlled keys. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this flaw over the network to elevate privileges, leading to a critical security impact.

Affected products:
- Azure Active Directory B2C

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-83711

## CVE-2026-62906

CVE-2026-62906 describes an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic within Microsoft Discovery Studio. This vulnerability allows an unauthorized remote attacker to perform unauthorized data disclosure over a network, potentially exposing sensitive information due to flawed query handling.

Affected products:
- Discovery Studio

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-62906

## CVE-2026-65818

CVE-2026-65818 is a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Microsoft Power Automate that enables an authorized attacker to perform privilege escalation over a network.

Affected products:
- Power Automate

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-65818

## CVE-2026-69857

CVE-2026-69857 describes an authorization bypass vulnerability in Azure Cosmos DB, where a user-controlled key allows an already authorized attacker to perform network spoofing, potentially escalating access or manipulating data communication.

Affected products:
- Azure Cosmos DB

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-69857

## CVE-2026-70178

CVE-2026-70178 is a privilege escalation vulnerability in Microsoft Fabric caused by a missing authorization check, which allows an attacker with existing network access to gain unauthorized elevated privileges.

Affected products:
- Fabric

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-70178

## CVE-2026-81963

CVE-2026-81963 is a link following vulnerability in the Microsoft Windows Update Stack that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges to SYSTEM. Detection engineers should prioritize patching affected assets in accordance with CISA's BOD 26-04 guidelines.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-81963

## CVE-2026-68839

CVE-2026-68839 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability within the Windows USB Mass Storage Class Driver. An unauthorized remote attacker can exploit this flaw to achieve remote code execution, indicating a significant security risk for Windows systems that interact with malicious USB mass storage devices over a network context.

Affected products:
- Windows USB Mass Storage Class Driver

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-68839

## CVE-2026-69276

CVE-2026-69276 describes an integer underflow vulnerability within the Microsoft UxTheme Library (uxtheme.dll). An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this flaw to achieve remote code execution over a network, carrying a CVSS base score of 9.8.

Affected products:
- UxTheme Library

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-69276

## CVE-2026-69356

- Exchange Server

- NTFS

- DirectMusic

## CVE-2026-69590

CVE-2026-69590 describes a critical Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerability within the Microsoft Windows Routing and Remote Access Service (RRAS). An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges on the target system, potentially leading to a full system compromise. The vulnerability is characterized by a CVSS v3.1 base score of 9.8, indicating high severity.

- Routing and Remote Access Service

## CVE-2026-69641

CVE-2026-69641 is a privilege escalation vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server resulting from a missing authorization check. An attacker who has already gained authorized access to the network can exploit this flaw to elevate their privileges, potentially gaining administrative control over the affected server instance.

Affected products:

## CVE-2026-56177

CVE-2026-56177 is a use-after-free vulnerability in Windows Server that enables an already authorized local attacker to elevate their privileges. Successful exploitation allows the attacker to execute code or perform operations with higher permissions than their initial account level, posing a significant risk to system security.

Affected products:
- Windows Server

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-56177

## CVE-2026-56198

CVE-2026-56198 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Microsoft Trace Data Helper component. An attacker with local authorization can exploit this flaw to escalate privileges on the affected Windows system.

Affected products:
- Trace Data Helper

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-56198

## CVE-2026-57098

CVE-2026-57098 describes an information disclosure vulnerability in the Windows RDP Client caused by improper verification of cryptographic signatures. This flaw allows an unauthorized attacker with network access to intercept or expose sensitive data during RDP communication, presenting a risk to secure remote access sessions.

Affected products:
- Windows RDP Client

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-57098

## CVE-2026-57099

CVE-2026-57099 is a denial-of-service vulnerability in ASP.NET Core resulting from improper allocation of resources without limits or throttling. An unauthorized remote attacker can exploit this flaw to exhaust system resources, leading to service unavailability.

Affected products:
- ASP.NET Core

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-57099













































































































Related in this roundup: [CVE-2026-69304](#cve-2026-69304).

## CVE-2026-58599

A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Microsoft Windows Codecs Library allows a local, unauthorized attacker to execute arbitrary code. The vulnerability is triggered by parsing malformed media files or data streams handled by the library, potentially leading to remote or local code execution.

Affected products:
- Windows Codecs Library

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-58599

- XBox Gaming Services

- Windows Push Notifications

- Windows Media Foundation

## CVE-2026-67378

CVE-2026-67378 describes an untrusted pointer dereference vulnerability in Microsoft SQL Server. This vulnerability allows an authorized attacker to achieve remote code execution over a network. Detection engineers should monitor for unauthorized or unusual execution patterns originating from database service accounts or anomalous memory access patterns indicative of exploitation attempts.

Affected products:
- SQL Server

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-67378

## CVE-2026-68827

- GDI+

- Remote Desktop Client

## CVE-2026-68834

CVE-2026-68834 is a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability residing in the Windows NTFS file system driver. This flaw allows a locally authorized attacker to perform privilege escalation across a network, potentially gaining elevated system rights.

Affected products:
- Windows

- Windows File History Service

## CVE-2026-68876

CVE-2026-68876 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability within the Windows Program Compatibility Assistant Service. The flaw allows an authorized attacker with network access to elevate their privileges on the host system.

Affected products:
- Windows Program Compatibility Assistant Service

- Windows

## CVE-2026-68878

CVE-2026-68878 describes a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability within the Windows Fast FAT Driver. This flaw allows an authenticated attacker to execute code or elevate privileges on a compromised system via network-based exploitation.

Affected products:
- Windows Fast FAT Driver

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-68878

## CVE-2026-68880

- Windows

## CVE-2026-68884

CVE-2026-68884 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Kernel that enables a locally authenticated attacker to perform a privilege escalation attack. Detection should focus on monitoring for anomalous kernel-mode memory access patterns or unexpected process token modifications initiated by low-privileged local user accounts.

Affected products:
- Windows Kernel

## CVE-2026-69266

CVE-2026-69266 is a vulnerability in the Windows DHCP Server component resulting from an integer overflow or wraparound condition. This flaw allows an unauthorized remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected server over a network, presenting a high risk to availability and system integrity.

Affected products:
- Windows DHCP Server

## CVE-2026-69271

CVE-2026-69271 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Microsoft Standard XPS. The vulnerability allows an authorized attacker with network access to achieve privilege escalation on the affected system by exploiting memory corruption within the XPS processing component.

## CVE-2026-69301

CVE-2026-69301 describes a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Win32K kernel-mode driver. This flaw allows an authorized attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code or elevate privileges on the target system, potentially leading to a full system compromise.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-69301

## CVE-2026-69305

CVE-2026-69305 is a use-after-free vulnerability within the Microsoft Windows Search Component. This flaw allows a locally authorized attacker to perform privilege escalation across a network, indicating a critical risk for internal lateral movement or gaining higher system authority.

Affected products:
- Windows Search Component

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-69305

## CVE-2026-69307

CVE-2026-69307 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability residing in the Windows USB Audio Class driver (usbaudio.sys). An authorized local attacker can exploit this flaw to achieve privilege escalation on affected Windows systems.

Affected products:
- Windows

## CVE-2026-69309

CVE-2026-69309 is a double free vulnerability in the Windows Print Spooler components that permits a locally authenticated attacker to perform a privilege escalation attack. Detection should focus on monitoring anomalous process behaviors or memory-related crashes originating from the Print Spooler service.

Affected products:
- Windows Print Spooler

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-69309

## CVE-2026-69310

CVE-2026-69310 describes a use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows DNS component. The vulnerability allows an attacker who already has local access to the system to exploit the memory corruption to escalate their privileges, potentially gaining higher-level administrative rights on the host.

Affected products:
- Windows DNS

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-69310

- Windows Audio Service

## CVE-2026-69312

CVE-2026-69312 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows NTFS filesystem driver. The flaw allows an authenticated local attacker to perform unauthorized actions or potentially elevate their privileges on the host system.

- Windows

## CVE-2026-69319

A race condition vulnerability in the Windows USB Video Driver allows a local, authorized attacker to achieve privilege escalation by exploiting improper synchronization during concurrent execution. The vulnerability is classified as a race condition, impacting system-level driver security.

Affected products:
- Windows USB Video Driver

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-69319

## CVE-2026-69324

CVE-2026-69324 is a type confusion vulnerability in the Windows Performance Monitor component. An attacker with local access can exploit this flaw to execute code or operations in a higher privilege context, resulting in local privilege escalation.

Affected products:
- Windows Performance Monitor

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-69324

## CVE-2026-69325

CVE-2026-69325 describes a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Microsoft JScript, which can be exploited by an unauthorized attacker to achieve remote code execution over a network. Detection efforts should focus on monitoring for anomalous JScript execution patterns or unexpected heap memory manipulation within the targeted Microsoft environment.

Affected products:
- JScript

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-69325

Affected products:
- Windows Storage

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-69328

- BranchCache

## CVE-2026-69334

CVE-2026-69334 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability within the Windows Volume Manager Extension Driver. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this flaw to achieve remote code execution over a network, potentially leading to a full system compromise.

Affected products:
- Windows Volume Manager Extension Driver

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-69334

## CVE-2026-69335

CVE-2026-69335 is a use-after-free vulnerability located in the Windows Win32k kernel driver. An authenticated local attacker can leverage this flaw to trigger memory corruption and achieve privilege escalation on the affected system.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-69335

## CVE-2026-69336

CVE-2026-69336 describes a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Microsoft Standard XPS. An authorized attacker can exploit this flaw over a network to achieve privilege escalation on the targeted system.

Affected products:

## CVE-2026-69412

CVE-2026-69412 is a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows DHCP Server component. - Windows DHCP Server

## CVE-2026-69448

CVE-2026-69448 describes a race condition vulnerability in the Windows Bluetooth Service that enables an authorized local attacker to elevate their privileges. Detection engineers should monitor for unauthorized modifications to system-level Bluetooth service processes or suspicious activity occurring within the context of the Bluetooth service account.

Affected products:
- Windows

## CVE-2026-69539

CVE-2026-69539 describes a use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft Remote Desktop Services that allows an authorized attacker to execute arbitrary code remotely. Detection engineers should monitor RDP traffic for anomalous behavior or unexpected process execution spawned from the Remote Desktop Services process (termsrv.exe).

Affected products:
- Remote Desktop Services

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69539

- Active Directory Domain Services

## CVE-2026-69553

CVE-2026-69553 is a privilege escalation vulnerability in Windows Hyper-V caused by missing authorization checks. An attacker with existing access can leverage this flaw to elevate their privileges over the network.

## CVE-2026-69627

CVE-2026-69627 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows Remote Desktop Licensing Service. An authorized, locally authenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to disclose sensitive information from the service's memory space.

Affected products:
- Windows Remote Desktop Licensing Service

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69627

## CVE-2026-69628

CVE-2026-69628 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability within the Windows iSCSI component that allows an authenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution over a network. Detection should focus on monitoring anomalous iSCSI traffic patterns and unexpected child processes spawning from system services associated with storage protocols.

Affected products:
- Windows iSCSI

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69628

## CVE-2026-69790

CVE-2026-69790 is a local elevation of privilege vulnerability in the Windows Credential Providers component caused by a heap-based buffer overflow. An authenticated attacker can exploit this flaw to gain higher privileges on the target system.

Affected products:
- Windows

- Windows

## CVE-2026-69693

A use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Device Association Broker service allows a locally authenticated attacker to elevate their privileges to a higher integrity level. This vulnerability requires the attacker to already have access to the system to exploit the flaw, typically targeting the service's memory management to achieve privilege escalation.

Affected products:
- Windows Device Association Broker service

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69693

## CVE-2026-69729

CVE-2026-69729 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability within Windows Credential Providers that enables an authorized attacker to achieve remote code execution over a network. Detection should focus on monitoring abnormal process execution behavior initiated by system-level credential handling services.

Affected products:
- Windows Credential Providers

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69729

## CVE-2026-69717

CVE-2026-69717 is a privilege escalation vulnerability in Windows Group Policy caused by an untrusted pointer dereference. An attacker with authorized access can exploit this flaw to elevate their privileges over the network.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69717

## CVE-2026-69862

CVE-2026-69862 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows Wireless Wide Area Network Service that enables an authenticated local attacker to perform information disclosure. Detection engineers should monitor for unusual access patterns or crashes associated with the wwansvc service.

Affected products:
- Windows Wireless Wide Area Network Service

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69862

## CVE-2026-69832

CVE-2026-69832 is an information disclosure vulnerability in the Windows Win32k component that allows a local, authorized attacker to gain access to sensitive system information due to improper handling of information in the control sphere.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69832

- Windows iSCSI Target Service

## CVE-2026-69772

- Windows Universal Disk Format File System Driver

## CVE-2026-69771

CVE-2026-69771 is a security feature bypass vulnerability in the Windows Container Manager Service. It is caused by improper link resolution before file access, which allows an authorized local attacker to perform unauthorized file operations, potentially leading to security feature bypass.

- Windows Container Manager Service

## CVE-2026-69732

CVE-2026-69732 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Link Layer Topology Discovery (LLTD) Protocol. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this via the network to achieve remote code execution on affected Windows systems.

Affected products:
- Windows Link Layer Topology Discovery Protocol

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69732

## CVE-2026-69770

CVE-2026-69770 is an information disclosure vulnerability in the Windows Spaceport.sys driver. The flaw is caused by the use of an uninitialized resource, which may allow an authorized local attacker to read sensitive information from memory.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69770

- Windows Key Distribution Center

## CVE-2026-69676

CVE-2026-69676 is a remote code execution vulnerability in Windows Kerberos caused by an authentication bypass via a capture-replay attack. An authorized attacker can leverage this flaw to execute arbitrary code over the network by capturing and replaying authentication traffic.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69676

- Windows

CVE-2026-70582 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in Windows Management Instrumentation caused by a race condition during concurrent execution with improper resource synchronization. An authorized attacker can exploit this flaw to elevate their privileges on an affected Windows system.

- Windows Management Instrumentation

## CVE-2026-70584

CVE-2026-70584 is a type confusion vulnerability within the Windows Core Messaging component that enables a locally authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. Detection should focus on monitoring for unauthorized process token manipulation or suspicious API calls associated with inter-process communication involving Windows Core Messaging.

Affected products:
- Windows Core Messaging

## CVE-2026-70585

CVE-2026-70585 is a use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows Services for NFS ONCRPC XDR Driver. An authenticated attacker can exploit this flaw to achieve local remote code execution by triggering memory corruption within the driver's handling of XDR data structures.

Affected products:
- Windows Services for NFS

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70585

## CVE-2026-70586

CVE-2026-70586 describes a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Microsoft Paint that enables a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. Detection should focus on monitoring anomalous process behaviors and memory corruption patterns initiated by the Paint application.

Affected products:
- Paint

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70586

## CVE-2026-70587

CVE-2026-70587 describes an information disclosure vulnerability in the Windows Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) resulting from improper null termination. This flaw allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to potentially read sensitive memory contents over the network without requiring user interaction.

Affected products:
- Windows Remote Desktop Protocol

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-70587

- Windows

## CVE-2026-69518

CVE-2026-69518 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Windows Remote Desktop that enables an unauthenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution over a network connection.

Affected products:
- Windows Remote Desktop

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69518

## CVE-2026-69544

CVE-2026-69544 describes a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows SMB Client that enables an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges on the local system.

Affected products:
- Windows SMB Client

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69544

## CVE-2026-69548

CVE-2026-69548 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows RNDIS (Remote Network Driver Interface Specification) component. The vulnerability permits an unauthorized attacker to disclose sensitive information, though successful exploitation requires physical access to the target device.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69548

## CVE-2026-72978

A denial of service vulnerability exists in Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services due to improper resource allocation and a lack of request throttling. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this flaw by sending specially crafted requests to the service, causing it to consume excessive resources and become unresponsive, thereby impacting the availability of authentication services.

Affected products:
- Active Directory Federation Services

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-72978

## CVE-2026-77495

A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Imaging Component allows an unauthorized remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. The vulnerability exists due to improper memory handling during image processing, enabling potential remote code execution over a network.

Affected products:
- Windows Imaging Component

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-77495

## CVE-2026-72981

CVE-2026-72981 is a remote code execution vulnerability residing in the IP Helper component of Windows, caused by a use-after-free memory management error. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this flaw by sending specifically crafted network traffic to a vulnerable host to achieve arbitrary code execution.

Affected products:
- Windows

## CVE-2026-77499

CVE-2026-77499 is a type confusion vulnerability in the Windows DHCP Server component that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to trigger a denial-of-service (DoS) condition. The vulnerability arises due to improper handling of resource types within the DHCP service, which can be exploited over the network to disrupt service availability.

Affected products:

## CVE-2026-72940

- Windows

## CVE-2026-69303

The Microsoft Push Message Routing Service is vulnerable to an out-of-bounds read, which can be exploited by an authorized attacker to achieve local information disclosure. This vulnerability requires local access to the target system to execute the necessary commands to trigger the out-of-bounds memory read.

Affected products:
- Push Message Routing Service

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69303

## CVE-2026-69350

CVE-2026-69350 is a privilege escalation vulnerability in the Windows Overlay Filter caused by a heap-based buffer overflow. An authorized local attacker can exploit this flaw to elevate their privileges on the system.

## CVE-2026-69358

CVE-2026-69358 describes a remote code execution vulnerability in the Microsoft Remote Desktop Client caused by the use of an uninitialized resource. An authorized attacker can exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code over the network.

Affected products:
- Remote Desktop Client

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69358

## CVE-2026-69357

CVE-2026-69357 is a use-after-free vulnerability within the Windows Network Driver Interface Specification (NDIS). An authenticated attacker can exploit this flaw to execute code with elevated privileges, potentially leading to a full system compromise. Detection efforts should focus on monitoring for unusual activity originating from network stack operations or anomalous kernel-mode memory access patterns.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69357

## CVE-2026-69535

A numeric truncation error in the Windows Spaceport.sys driver allows a locally authenticated attacker to elevate their privileges to a higher integrity level. The vulnerability involves improper handling of numeric data within the driver, facilitating exploitation via local access.

## CVE-2026-69538

An out-of-bounds read vulnerability exists in the Windows Spaceport.sys driver, which can be leveraged by an authorized attacker to achieve local remote code execution. The vulnerability is classified as an out-of-bounds read issue, which can lead to memory corruption and subsequent code execution.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69538

## CVE-2026-69542

CVE-2026-69542 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in the Windows Camera Frame Server Monitor component. The vulnerability is caused by a heap-based buffer overflow, which allows an attacker who already has local access to the system to escalate their privileges.

Affected products:
- Windows Camera Frame Server Monitor

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69542

## CVE-2026-69591

CVE-2026-69591 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Windows NTFS file system that enables an authenticated attacker to perform information disclosure over a network connection.

Affected products:
- Windows

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69591

## CVE-2026-69616

CVE-2026-69616 is an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Windows Remote Desktop Services that permits an authorized, locally authenticated attacker to disclose sensitive information from the system. Detection engineers should monitor for abnormal memory access patterns or unauthorized attempts to query system memory via RDP-related services.

Affected products:
- Remote Desktop Services

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69616

## CVE-2026-69654

CVE-2026-69654 is a privilege escalation vulnerability in Windows Accounts Control caused by a use-after-free flaw. An authorized local attacker can exploit this vulnerability to elevate their privileges on the affected system.

Affected products:
- Windows Accounts Control

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69654

## CVE-2026-69816

CVE-2026-69816 is a use-after-free vulnerability within Windows Accounts Control that enables an authorized local attacker to perform an elevation of privilege attack. This vulnerability requires the attacker to already have a foothold on the system to execute the exploit.

Affected products:
- Windows Accounts Control

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69816

Affected products:
- Windows Device Association Service

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69714

## CVE-2026-69709

CVE-2026-69709 describes a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability within the Windows New Technology File System (NTFS) driver. A local, authorized attacker can exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges on the affected system.

Affected products:

- Windows

- Windows Secure Boot

## CVE-2026-69779

CVE-2026-69779 is a Time-of-Check Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability in the Windows Win32k subsystem. Successful exploitation allows a local, authorized attacker to elevate their privileges on the host system.

## CVE-2026-69672

CVE-2026-69672 is an information disclosure vulnerability in the Windows DNS component caused by the use of uninitialized resources. An authenticated attacker can exploit this flaw locally to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information.

Affected products:
- Windows DNS

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69672

## CVE-2026-69809

CVE-2026-69809 is a denial of service vulnerability in Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services caused by a memory leak (missing release of memory) occurring after an object's effective lifetime. An unauthorized attacker can exploit this flaw over the network to crash the service or degrade performance.

Affected products:
- Active Directory Domain Services

Source: https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-69809

CVE-2026-69853 describes an information disclosure vulnerability in the Windows Win32K component caused by the use of an uninitialized resource. A local, authorized attacker can exploit this flaw to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information residing in memory.

- Windows

- Windows Web Platform Storage

## CVE-2026-69878
